description.p: Kuby is a native multi-cluster Kubernetes desktop client built with Tauri 2, Rust (kube-rs), and SolidJS.

ul.li: Multi-cluster kubeconfig contexts with KUBECONFIG support
Generic API discovery and DynamicObject access including CRDs
Curated views for approximately 30 core resource kinds
Detail views, YAML apply, logs, exec, and port-forward capabilities
Aggregated logs with global search and multi-namespace selector
Side-by-side YAML diff and metrics.k8s.io CPU/RAM monitoring
Auth summaries for OIDC/kubelogin, EKS/GKE/AKS exec plugins, client certificates, and Teleport

screenshot.caption: Workload overview with cluster sidebar, status cards, warnings, restarts, and resource usage
